name: finance-close-review
description: Finance and AP close-review tasks using a shared ERP/compliance API. Use this skill whenever the user asks about closing a finance batch, reconciling claims or invoices against bills and payments, reviewing vendor or business onboarding against compliance evidence, performing prepaid amortization reconciliation, or releasing payments after account-change events. The skill covers cross-referencing multiple API endpoints, classification of items into decision buckets, and producing structured JSON answers that match an answer-template specification. Use it for any task that mentions claims, AP bills, payments, prepaid invoices, GL balances, vendor onboarding, compliance screening, or close/release review in a finance-operations context, even if the user does not say "close review" explicitly.
